changes: Traceability remains complete and ordered, but each statement may reference a real core operation or BROWSER: observation; no new function is required per quality/scenario.
UI qualities must be implemented through HTML/CSS/events/local assets and independently observed; quality flags and self-certified completion are not evidence.
The browser instruction requires real field reads, calculation calls, visible results/errors, screen changes and state preservation; comments and console.log are not implementations.

Test instructions require independently derived results and valid JavaScript escaping, prohibit quality flags/function-existence tests as proof of UI behavior, and preserve independent browser obligations.
Implementation files describe exported signatures; test files describe framework registration such as test(name,callback); HTML describes DOM identities.

Retry feedback encodes whitespace reversibly inside JSON to satisfy the unchanged normalized-text contract. The decoded excerpt is identical to source bytes, with full hash and explicit offsets/truncation; no source repair or validator weakening occurs.
